exposure: neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) at relapse during pregnancy
time interval between the last relapse and conception
cohort: The single-center study included 33 AQP4-IgG-positive neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) patients (34 pregnancies) out of 117 women with AQP4 antibody-positive NMOSD, which was further supplemented by cohorts from a meta-analysis.
finding: Maintenance of immunosuppressive treatment during pregnancy significantly reduces pregnancy-related attacks and the relapse rate in AQP4-IgG-positive NMOSD patients, but it is associated with a higher occurrence of unhealthy newborns.
